summary: Generation Income Properties, Inc. filed an 8-K to report an amendment to the operating agreement of its Iowa SPE subsidiary that holds a Best Buy-leased property. The amendment eliminates an accrued preferred return component, reduces JCWC's distribution preference from an 8.0% cumulative return (6.5% cash + 1.5% accrual) to a simplified 6.5% annual cash return, and adds automatic one-year extensions to the two-year term. This is a routine refinancing of a prior joint-venture term sheet, not a special situation. No acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, or other corporate event is involved.
